subject: Upcoming Travel Booking Confirmation
body: Dear [Recipient], I hope this email finds you well. We are excited to confirm your upcoming travel booking for your trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: Flight: ABC123, Departure: 15th June 2023, 9:00 AM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. Should you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Warm regards, The Travel Agency Team
